T: Back to school, back to lunch.
D: A rich man-child has to repeat grades one to twelve in six months to inherit his father's hotel empire.
P: Serve the snacks when Billy starts first grade.
S: Grade one ham and cheese pinwheels
Tortilla rolls with ham, cheddar, spinach and mustard cream cheese

Soft tortilla pinwheels rolled with leg ham, cream cheese, cheddar and baby spinach, sliced into rounds and served with cherry tomatoes and pickles. Mix 150g soft cream cheese with 1 tbsp mustard. Spread thinly over 4 large flour tortillas right to the edges. Layer each with 2 slices of leg ham, a handful of baby spinach and 30g grated cheddar. Roll up tightly, wrap in cling film and chill for 30 minutes so they hold their shape. Trim the ends and cut each roll into 6 pinwheels. Serve on a platter with 250g cherry tomatoes and a few cornichons.
Triple-decker toast with chicken, bacon, lettuce and tomato

Triple-decker toasted club sandwiches with roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise, cut into bite-size squares and pinned with toothpicks. Grill 6 rashers bacon until crisp. Toast 12 slices white bread. Spread with 4 tbsp mayonnaise. For each of 4 sandwiches, layer toast, 50g sliced cooked chicken, lettuce and tomato, then toast, bacon and lettuce, then the last toast. Press down gently and pin with 4 toothpicks. Trim the crusts and cut each into 4 squares. Serve with a handful of salted potato crisps on the side.
M: Hot dogs under spiced beef chilli and melted cheese

Grilled frankfurts in toasted buns loaded with beef chilli, melted cheddar, diced white onion and yellow mustard, with plenty of napkins. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp chilli powder, 200g tomato passata and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Grill 8 frankfurts for 6 minutes, turning. Toast 8 split hot dog buns. Fill each bun with a frankfurt, spoon over the chilli and top with 120g grated cheddar. Grill 2 minutes until melted, then add diced white onion and a squeeze of mustard.
Honey mustard to dip. Back at school at 27
Chicken tenderloins in a cornflake and parmesan crumb, baked crisp, with a honey mustard dip and carrot sticks.
W: Stovetop chocolate pudding chilled in small cups

Smooth homemade chocolate pudding set in cups, topped with whipped cream, crushed chocolate biscuits and rainbow sprinkles. Whisk 80g caster sugar, 30g cocoa, 30g cornflour and a pinch of salt in a saucepan. Slowly whisk in 600ml milk, then stir over medium heat for 6 minutes until it boils and thickens. Take off the heat and stir in 80g chopped milk chocolate and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth. Pour into 4 cups, press cling film on the surface and chill 2 hours. Top with whipped cream from 200ml thickened cream, 4 crushed chocolate biscuits and sprinkles.
K: Back to school chocolate malt shake
Vanilla ice cream, chocolate sauce and malt blended thick

Thick chocolate milkshakes blended with malt and ice cream, topped with whipped cream and a drizzle of chocolate sauce. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Drizzle 2 tbsp chocolate sauce down the inside of each glass. Blend 600ml cold milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 3 tbsp cocoa until thick and smooth. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and finish with an extra drizzle of chocolate sauce and a sprinkle of malt.

dishes.n: Grade one ham and cheese pinwheels
dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep rolled and chilled

steps.text: Mix the cream cheese and mustard until smooth, then spread thinly over the tortillas right to the edges.
Layer ham, spinach and grated cheddar over each tortilla.
Roll up tightly and wrap in cling film.
Chill so the rolls hold their shape.
Trim the ends, cut each roll into pinwheels and serve with cherry tomatoes and cornichons.

steps.text: Mix the cream cheese and mustard until smooth, then spread thinly over the tortillas right to the edges.
Layer the drained roasted capsicum strips, baby spinach and grated cheddar over each tortilla.
Roll up tightly and wrap in cling film.
Chill so the rolls hold their shape.
Trim the ends, cut each roll into pinwheels and serve with cherry tomatoes and cornichons.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep covered and chilled

steps.text: Grill the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise.
Build each sandwich with toast, chicken, lettuce and tomato, then toast, bacon and lettuce, then the last slice of toast.
Press down gently, pin with toothpicks, trim the crusts and cut into squares. Serve with crisps.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep covered and chilled

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and slice.
Slice the smoked tofu thinly and fry in the oil until crisp on both sides.
Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise.
Build each sandwich with toast, egg, lettuce and tomato, then toast, crisp tofu and lettuce, then the last slice of toast.
Press down gently, pin with toothpicks, trim the crusts and cut into squares. Serve with the potato crisps.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the chilli up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled, or freeze up to 1 month; reheat, then grill the dogs and assemble on the night

steps.text: Brown the mince with the diced onion, then add the cumin, smoked paprika, chilli powder, passata and a splash of water.
Simmer until thick.
Grill the frankfurts, turning, and toast the split buns.
Fill the buns with frankfurts and chilli, top with cheddar and grill until melted.
Finish with raw diced onion and a squeeze of mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Make the plant-based chilli up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled, or freeze up to 1 month; reheat, then grill the frankfurts and assemble on the night

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince with the diced onion in the oil, then add the cumin, smoked paprika, chilli powder, passata and a splash of water.
Simmer until thick.
Grill the vegetarian frankfurts, turning, and toast the split buns.
Fill the buns with frankfurts and chilli, top with cheddar and grill until melted.
Finish with raw diced onion and a squeeze of mustard.

dishes.make_ahead: Crumb the tenders up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge; bake on the night

steps.text: Mix the cornflakes with the parmesan, paprika and salt.
Dip the chicken in flour, beaten egg and the cornflake crumb and lay on an oiled tray. Drizzle with oil.
Bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp and cooked through.
Stir the honey into the mustard and serve with the tenders and carrot sticks.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb up to 4 hours ahead; bake on the night

steps.text: Mix the cornflakes with the paprika.
Dip the haloumi in flour, egg and crumb, lay on an oiled tray and drizzle with oil.
Bake at 220C until crisp. Serve with honey mustard and carrot sticks.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled with cling film on the surface

steps.text: Whisk the sugar, cocoa, cornflour and salt in a saucepan, then slowly whisk in the milk.
Stir over medium heat until it boils and thickens.
Off the heat, stir in the chocolate and vanilla until smooth. Pour into cups and press cling film on the surface.
Chill until set.
Whip the cream and top each cup with cream, crushed biscuits and sprinkles.

dishes.n: Back to school chocolate malt shake
dishes.make_ahead: Chill the glasses in the freezer and whip the cream up to 2 hours ahead; blend just before serving

ingredients.item: chocolate sauce, plus extra to finish

steps.text: Chill tall glasses in the freezer.
Drizzle chocolate sauce down the inside of each glass.
Blend the milk, ice cream, malted milk powder and cocoa until thick and smooth, then pour into the glasses.
Top with whipped cream, more chocolate sauce and a sprinkle of malt powder.
